answer: Simultaneous load audits expose farms where many keys share one machine. At a random minute each epoch, the ledger lights a lantern: a signed broadcast that hands every agent key in a garden, a batch of 2,000 keys, its own fresh reasoning task due within 90 seconds. Rotating graders score the replies, and a key that misses the window or returns filler is marked hollow; 2 hollow marks in 10 epochs forfeit its rewards. An operator running 500 fakes on one GPU must answer 500 tasks at once, so it has to rent peak compute for every key at every audit.
